title: Freeze small protocols, held-outs and promotion gates

gates_verbatim_from_promotion_policy.section: PROMOTION_POLICY.md 'Proposed quantitative gates to freeze at N8-03' - copied verbatim; these are THE final gates
gates_verbatim_from_promotion_policy.intro: These are engineering acceptance thresholds, not observed results. Freeze exactly or justify amendments using baseline noise/cost characterization BEFORE evaluating new candidates, recording a new protocol version. After candidate failures, do not loosen gates.
bullets: Exact supported-domain numerical/metadata/state, full API/DX and memory gates are mandatory.

Use three alternating paired observations per final selected small held-out cell, not an exhaustive grid. Primary evaluation has at least four predeclared workload/configuration cells covering dense and vegetation scenes plus ordinary defaults and production H/B; use tuning cases only to choose variants.
Installed auto default must yield geometric mean `A0_time / auto_time >= 1.10` across the declared primary native-eligible cells.

Each primary cell used in the auto-native allow-list must have paired median `A0_time / auto_time >= 1.05`; every such cell must have paired median `B1_time / auto_time >= 1.05` at the installed region/pipeline boundary. Native-specific value cannot be credited solely to B1's layout.

No more than 3% paired median regression in a predeclared protected default/fallback cell. A new degraded or noisy cell is removed from auto eligibility only with explicit guard coverage and prior workload-domain policy, not erased from reports. Never shrink the target workload definition to hide a failure.

Meaningful native coverage: required output has been computed by actual native region on >=80% of PREDECLARED eligible pixel-patch work in a primary cell; overall absolute coverage and fallback workload are reported. Counters must verify actual C execution, not initialization. A mask cache or mixed region needs a defined non-double-counted work unit.

First-use native library initialization performs no build/download. Cold full-entry guard must not materially regress beyond the predeclared 3% paired bound where valid paired data exists; unresolved host noise means insufficient evidence, not passed.

A noisy host, memory-pressure interruption, unmatched layout/profile/resource, missing completed pair or synthetic-only default extrapolation invalidates promotion evidence for the affected cell. Preserve censored runs and investigate via small repro before at most one permitted rerun.
gates_verbatim_from_promotion_policy.closing: These small-sample gates establish local scoped evidence, not a p95 service-level guarantee. A large claimed speedup requires enough evidence for that claim; the design aim of 20-23 minutes is not measured here.

exactness_gates.mandatory_for_admission: B1 and C1 admission is conditional on the N8-04 frozen typed LW contract (optimization_v8_native_default/evidence/contract/n8_04_typed_lw_contract.json) and a green tests/optimization_v8/reference/ suite (112 tests collected at freeze) BEFORE any timing
exactness_gates.bitwise_rule: uint32 view of all seven output columns bitwise-identical to A0 on the admitted domain (uint64-level digest of the packed output equivalent per contract); f64 surface-scalar profile is the real pipeline profile, f32 is the frozen synthetic profile - both share one provenance per contract 1.4
exactness_gates.domain_rule: a candidate implements the full admitted domain or restricts admission explicitly; inputs outside the admitted subset must be REJECTED to the Numba path (decline cell PR2), never silently mis-executed
exactness_gates.no_performance_exemption: capability/exactness failures disqualify a timed run regardless of speed

timing_boundaries.source: BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md - record all five; do not substitute
timing_boundaries.leaf_kernel: prepared native pointers/arrays, synchronous result; no claim of application gain.
timing_boundaries.region_total: checks, owner leases, decode, exact classifier, layout, pool dispatch, two sweeps, synchronization, output placement; all costs required per execution included.
timing_boundaries.workflow_warm: real public API/CLI over prepared unchanged geometry, all output/checkpoint work included, native artifacts already installed. Record residual startup.
timing_boundaries.workflow_first_use: start before required imports/initialization for that deployment profile; include validation, preparation, geometry and durable publication. Build a release wheel before this timer, because end users receive it; old dev-build time belongs to a separately labelled dev case. Do not subtract imports for candidate while retaining them for baseline.
timing_boundaries.target_campaign: actual K=24 spatial tiles, 24 records each, actual extents/overlap/resolution, frozen flags and total resource envelope, artifacts complete.
rules: measure lazy/native COMPLETION, not enqueue time
instrumented and uninstrumented timings kept separate (n8-02 measured instrumented delta -1.75%..+2.69%, ~157ns/call wrapper)
independent child processes for every H (threads/workers) change; verify actual Numba/native pool sizes inside tile children, not env strings
cold full-entry guard only where valid paired data exists; unresolved host noise = insufficient evidence, not passed

host_identity_frozen.machine: Apple M1 Pro, arm64, 10 cores, 16 GiB RAM
host_identity_frozen.site: worktree src (editable); comparisons against installed wheel use the N8-20 packaged artifact

budgets_and_schedule.exclusive_lease: one benchmark owner at a time on this host; no other builds/tests/measurements during timed trials; quiet-host monitoring is read-only and never terminates user applications
budgets_and_schedule.ambient_recording: ambient load + memory snapshot in a window BEFORE and AFTER every timed block (os.getloadavg + ps tree, as n8_02); a flagged window edge does not censor a run by itself - only memory-pressure kills and unmatched configs do

paired_reps.triage: 2 alternating pairs (T1 real scene + one 128 cell; tuning cases only, choose variants)
paired_reps.finalists: 3 alternating pairs per primary cell P1..P6
paired_reps.order: A/C then C/A alternating, or a frozen seeded randomized schedule recorded BEFORE the runs
paired_reps.summary_labels: paired medians and aggregate geometric means are labelled OBSERVED SMALL-SAMPLE SUMMARIES, never significance claims

censoring: memory-pressure kill = failed/censored run: recorded, never erased; a retry does not remove it
noisy host / unmatched layout/profile/resource / missing completed pair invalidates the affected cell's promotion evidence; investigate via small reproducer before AT MOST one permitted rerun
admission failures under load are environment-blocked attempts, not candidate defects
budgets_and_schedule.final_campaign: after local candidate freeze exactly ONE final large workload: actual 24-tile corpus if present and qualified, else the predeclared synthetic 4-tile scale guard labelled not-actual-target; one candidate run + zero new large baselines when valid matched evidence exists; at most one justified fresh A baseline; at most one causal retry after a small reproducer/fix/re-freeze

native_execution_proof.counter_point: C-entry counters incremented AT THE ADMITTED FUNCTION POINTER on completed pixel-patch work (n8-02 pattern: native_c_entry.f64 / native_adapter.admitted / island.numba_lw_primary), plus call counts, scalar/layout/profile identity and artifact generation id
native_execution_proof.coverage_rule: per primary cell: eligible work = every LW pixel-patch block call of the cell's 24-step chronology (predeclared rule; the integer denominator is recorded from the first control run and MUST be identical across arms or the pair is invalid - n8-02 reference values: 432 = 48 steps x 9 blocks at 32x35 B=128; 96 at B=1024); gate = native-completed / eligible >= 80% with overall absolute coverage AND fallback workload both reported
native_execution_proof.not_proof: build stamps, cache-dir contents or a loaded module alone do not prove execution; pre-launch fallbacks and errors are counted separately
native_execution_proof.timing_runs: low-overhead aggregated counters inside timing runs; detailed per-call timers only in separate diagnostic runs

measured_context_frozen_before_variants.decode_share: decode_block ~41% of Lcyl (40.9% default B=128 / 46.7% default B=1024 / 41.5% native B=1024, per-call-mean estimates)
